advancedHelp.targetTimeoutMs: Optional per-target timeout. Empty inherits the current request timeout; larger values are capped to that timeout.
advancedHelp.connectionAwareExpansion: When on, this combo expands each provider-level step into per-account targets before rotating. Inherit uses the global default (off). Off keeps provider-level rotation.

featureFlagArenaEloSyncEnabledDescriptio: Enable periodic Arena AI leaderboard ELO sync for model intelligence rankings.
featureFlagBatchAndFileAutoCleanupEnable: Let the automatic cleanup sweep delete terminal (completed/failed/cancelled/expired) Batch API jobs older than OMNIROUTE_BATCH_RETENTION_DAYS, along with their per-line checkpoints, and clear the BLOB content of uploaded files past their own expires_at. Off by default: every existing install keeps this data exactly as before until an operator opts in. The operator-triggered DELETE /api/v1/batches/delete-completed route is unaffected either way -- it is a separate, unconditional public API contract.
featureFlagCapabilityFilterEnabledDescri: Reject requests before dispatch when the target model lacks required capabilities (vision, tools, structured output, context window). Protects direct single-provider requests that bypass the combo-layer compatibility filter.
featureFlagChatVirtualLanesEnabledDescri: Enable per-tenant adaptive virtual admission lanes for provider dispatch (#9654): one tenant's burst no longer 503s another. The OMNIROUTE_CHAT_VIRTUAL_LANES env var wins over this dashboard override; changes take effect at server restart.
featureFlagDbHealthcheckStartupDeferredE: Run the startup database integrity/health check after the server starts accepting requests instead of blocking startup until it completes. Off by default: startup blocks on the check exactly like before this change, so a corrupt database is still caught before the first request is served.
featureFlagDisableContextWindowChecksDes: Skip OmniRoute's local context-window and max-input-token check for direct single-model requests. Upstream providers still enforce their actual limits. Prompt compression and output-token caps remain active.
featureFlagExposeCcDiscoveryAliasesDescr: Advertise claude/<provider>/<model> mirror ids on /v1/models so Claude Code gateway model discovery lists non-Claude models. Warning: doubles catalog entries for all clients when enabled globally.
featureFlagExposeFunctionalGatewayMirror: Advertise '<gateway-alias>'/'<model>' mirror ids on /v1/models for models whose canonical owner has no active credential but a passthrough gateway with an active credential routes them. Warning: adds catalog entries for all clients when enabled globally.
featureFlagFreeBadgeRequiresProviderFree: Dashboard provider pages: show the Free badge only on signals the provider honors — drops the display-name heuristic, non-boolean free fields and :free suffixes on registered providers without a documented free tier. Off keeps the historical badge rule.
featureFlagNoThinkingAliasEnabledDescrip: Master switch for the no-think/<provider>/<model> gateway aliases. On (default): /v1/models advertises a no-thinking variant for every eligible thinking-capable Claude model, and a no-think/ id sent on a request resolves back to the real model with reasoning suppressed. Off: no variants are advertised and a no-think/ id is treated like any other unknown model id. The per-model ModelSpec.noThinkingAlias opt-in/opt-out still applies while this is on.
featureFlagOmnirouteDisableThinkingLevel: Disable the generation of thinking level variants (e.g. -low, -medium, -high) in the /v1/models catalog.
featureFlagOmnirouteEmergencyFallbackDes: Route budget-exhausted requests to the emergency free fallback provider/model.
featureFlagProxyHealthBlockedResetsStrea: In the proxy health sweep, let a probe the target refused (401/403/429: the proxy relayed, the destination refused this egress IP) reset the consecutive-failure streak of the proxy, like a served probe. Off by default: a refusal stays neutral and keeps the streak. A 5xx stays inconclusive either way, and a refusal never removes, disables or re-activates a proxy.
featureFlagProxyPoolEgressObservationDes: Show, under a proxy pool in the dashboard, how many observed egress IPs served its members over the last 24 h, how many connections used them and the most seen behind one IP. Read-only, computed from the proxy log, never used for routing. Off by default: the pool editor is unchanged and the observation route answers null.
featureFlagProxySkipRecentlyFailedDescri: Proxy pools and the per-account rotation of opencode stop re-serving a proxy that just failed (refused TCP probe, or a 429 received through it) for a per-process period that doubles on each repeat, up to a cap. No proxy status is written; with every candidate set aside the choice is unchanged. On by default; `false` restores plain selection.

OMNIROUTE_ALLOW_LOCAL_PROVIDER_URLS.description: Allow providers on localhost, LAN, and private IP ranges. This is required for local OpenAI-compatible models and enabled by default. Cloud-metadata endpoints such as 169.254.169.254 remain blocked.

OMNIROUTE_ALLOW_PRIVATE_PROVIDER_URLS.description: Allow provider URLs that point to private or internal networks.

OMNIROUTE_AUTO_SYNC_CLAUDE_PROFILES.description: After provider-model synchronization, regenerate ~/.claude/profiles/'<name>'/settings.json profiles from the live catalog. This never changes the active or default Claude configuration and is off by default.

OMNIROUTE_AUTO_SYNC_CODEX_PROFILES.description: After provider-model synchronization, regenerate ~/.codex/*.config.toml profiles from the live catalog. This never changes the active or default Codex configuration and is off by default.

OMNIROUTE_CODEX_WS_ENABLED.description: Allow Codex to use Responses over WebSocket. When disabled, Codex falls back to HTTP Responses.

OMNIROUTE_CONTROL_PLANE_PROXY_DIRECT_FAL.description: Allow OAuth and provider-validation flows to bypass a pinned proxy when proxy reachability checks fail. Off by default because this can change the account egress IP.

OMNIROUTE_DISABLE_BACKGROUND_SERVICES.description: Disable all background services, including quota refresh and synchronization.

OMNIROUTE_DISABLE_LOCAL_HEALTHCHECK.description: Disable the local instance health-check endpoint.

OMNIROUTE_EMERGENCY_FALLBACK.description: Route budget-exhausted requests to the emergency free fallback provider and model.

OMNIROUTE_ENABLE_LIVE_WS.description: Start the real-time dashboard WebSocket server on import at loopback port 20132. Set the flag to 0 or false to disable it. LAN exposure also requires LIVE_WS_HOST=0.0.0.0 and LIVE_WS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.

OMNIROUTE_MCP_COMPRESS_DESCRIPTIONS.description: Compress MCP tool descriptions to reduce token usage.

OMNIROUTE_MCP_ENFORCE_SCOPES.description: Enforce scope restrictions for MCP tool access.

OMNIROUTE_RTK_TRUST_PROJECT_FILTERS.description: Trust project-level RTK filters without validation.

OUTBOUND_SSRF_GUARD_ENABLED.description: Block outbound requests to private or internal IP ranges.

PII_REDACTION_ENABLED.description: Redact personally identifiable information from requests.

PII_RESPONSE_SANITIZATION.description: Sanitize personally identifiable information in provider responses.

PII_RESPONSE_SANITIZATION_MODE.description: Choose how response PII is handled: redact replaces it, warn only logs it, block rejects the response, and off disables sanitization.

PRICING_SYNC_ENABLED.description: Synchronize pricing data automatically. The PRICING_SYNC_ENABLED environment variable must also be true.

PROTECTED_PRIORITY_INFRA_502_ENABLED.description: Answer 502 instead of 503 when a quota-only-fallback priority target stops the combo for a cause that is provably not quota: an open provider circuit breaker or a predictive latency skip.
PROTECTED_PRIORITY_INFRA_502_ENABLED.label: Protected-Priority Infra Stops as 502

PROXY_AUTO_SELECT_ENABLED.description: When no proxy is assigned to a connection, automatically select the first working registry proxy. Off by default because otherwise one registry proxy becomes a global fallback for all traffic (#3332).

RATE_LIMIT_AUTO_ENABLE.description: Automatically enable rate limiting based on usage patterns.

REQUIRE_API_KEY.description: Require an API key for all incoming requests.

RESPONSES_PASSTHROUGH_DROP_COMMENTARY.description: Remove internal commentary-phase output items from Responses API passthrough streams before forwarding them to clients. Disable this flag to receive raw upstream commentary.

RETRY_AFTER_PROVENANCE_ENABLED.description: On aggregated 429/503 unavailable responses, omit Retry-After when no concrete future retry time is known instead of sending a synthetic 1s, add error.retry_after_provenance, and read prose retry hints on combo drain paths.
RETRY_AFTER_PROVENANCE_ENABLED.label: Retry-After Provenance

SERVER_OWNED_TOOL_LOOP_ENABLED.description: Continue non-streaming server-owned tool calls until the model returns a client-usable response.
SERVER_OWNED_TOOL_LOOP_ENABLED.label: Server-Owned Tool Loop

SKILLS_SANDBOX_NETWORK_ENABLED.description: Enable network access in the skills sandbox.

STREAM_EARLY_EOF_SIBLING_FAILOVER_ENABLE.description: Fail over once to a sibling connection when a stream closes before emitting any useful frame and the bounded same-connection retry is spent. With no usable sibling, the original early-EOF error is returned. Off: early-EOF stays terminal after the retry.

STREAM_RECOVERY_ENABLED.description: Retry truncated upstream SSE streams transparently before any response bytes reach the client.

STREAM_RECOVERY_MIDSTREAM_ENABLED.description: Allow stream recovery to request the response again and stitch it after bytes have already reached the client.

STREAM_RECOVERY_TOOLCALL_ORDER_FIX.description: Make mid-stream continuation tool-call safe: never resume a cut stream after a tool call was sent (still in progress or already finished), and stop after one empty continuation instead of using the whole retry budget.

TOOL_POLICY_MODE.description: Set the tool-use policy enforcement mode.

concept.description: OmniRoute learns from every conversation, remembering facts, episodes, procedures, and semantic concepts that make responses more accurate and context-aware.
concept.howWorksContent:
1. Automatic extraction: at the end of each response, facts and episodes are detected and saved automatically.
2. Retrieval: before each response, the most relevant memories are searched via FTS5 (exact), vector (semantic), or hybrid RRF.
3. Injection: relevant memories are injected into the assistant context to improve response quality.
4. Management: use this page to view, edit, export, and compact old memories.
concept.title: Conversational Memory

omniglyph.description: Context-as-image compression. Renders the system prompt, tool documentation, and dense history as compact PNG pages for the measured Claude Fable 5 path. The published OmniGlyph package also exposes native GPT 5.6 transformers, but OmniRoute keeps those routes fail-closed until provider fidelity and reading receipts exist.

economics.fewerTokens: fewer tokens on the converted block
economics.imageTokens: image tokens for a 1568×728 page (about 28k characters)

omniglyph.enableDescription: Runs last in the stack after text engines clean the request, using the native provider wire; OpenAI Chat/Responses requests are compressed after translation so their shape is preserved. It also runs standalone through omniglyph mode. This is a preview and remains off by default until end-to-end validation is complete.

format.label: Format
format.why: The body must match the provider wire: Claude Messages, OpenAI Chat Completions, or native OpenAI Responses input[].

model.label: Model
model.why: Only the measured Fable 5 path is enabled in OmniRoute. GPT 5.6 is structurally supported by the package but remains blocked until its provider receipt; unverified families such as Grok stay text-only.

profitable.label: Profitable
profitable.why: The exact 28px-patch cost gate decides per request; small or sparse text passes through untouched.

transport.label: Transport
transport.why: Aggregators may resample images and destroy legibility — only a direct provider route is authoritative.

omniglyph.gatesDescription: Fail-closed: every gate must pass, or the request passes through untouched (each skip is recorded as skip:<reason>).
omniglyph.profileDescription: The profile is a ceiling, not a floor: a stricter profile cannot be reopened by a per-step override. Measured on this codebase: with coding-safe or balanced, a session that has not accumulated history yet compresses nothing, because both raise the minimum-characters threshold and keep the system prompt, tool schemas and tool results native.

aggressive.description: The policy the published receipts measured. Images the system prompt, tool documentation and dense history.
aggressive.label: Aggressive (default)

balanced.description: Keeps live state native and protects the last 8 turns; only collapses older closed history.
balanced.label: Balanced

codingSafe.description: Keeps authority, tool schemas and live tool output native, protecting the last 12 turns. Compresses nothing until the session accumulates history.
codingSafe.label: Coding-safe

passthrough.description: Routes without transforming. The engine is skipped and the request is forwarded untouched.
passthrough.label: Passthrough

onboardingProviderDescriptions.bai: Bearer API key for the b.ai OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway (distinct from TheB.AI). Create a key at https://docs.b.ai, then use https://api.b.ai/v1 as the OpenAI-compatible base URL.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.bailian-coding-plan: Connect Alibaba Coding Plan with an API key.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.baseten: $30 free trial credits for GPU inference
onboardingProviderDescriptions.bazaarlink: Create a free API key at https://bazaarlink.ai — model 'auto:free' routes to zero-cost inference. All models use the provider/model-name format, e.g. xiaomi/mimo-v2.5-pro.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.bedrock: Native Bedrock integration: model discovery uses Bedrock foundation models and inference profiles, while chat uses the regional Bedrock Runtime Converse/ConverseStream APIs.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.black-forest-labs: Connect Black Forest Labs with an API key.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.blackbox: Free tier: unlimited basic chat plus Minimax-M2.5, no credit card required
onboardingProviderDescriptions.bluesminds: Get your API key at https://www.bluesminds.com — OpenAI-compatible endpoint at https://api.bluesminds.com/v1 with free daily credits. VIP models (Claude Opus 4.5, Gemini 2.5 Pro) consume pi credits.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.byteplus: Connect BytePlus ModelArk with an API key.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.cerebras: One-time $5 signup credit (30-day validity); a payment method is required. Not a recurring free tier.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.charm-hyper: Create an API key at https://hyper.charm.land, then paste it here as a Bearer token.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.chenzk: OpenAI-compatible gateway with a live model catalog at chenzk.top.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.chutes: Bearer API key for the Chutes OpenAI-compatible gateway.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.clarifai: Clarifai exposes OpenAI-compatible chat, responses and /models on /v2/ext/openai/v1. Public/community models typically require a PAT; app-scoped keys only work for resources inside that app.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.claude: Connect Claude Code with the existing OAuth flow.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.cline: Connect Cline with the existing OAuth flow.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.cloudflare-ai: Requires API Token AND Account ID (found at dash.cloudflare.com)
onboardingProviderDescriptions.clova-studio: CLOVA Studio (HyperCLOVA X) is OpenAI-compatible on /v1/openai. OmniRoute probes /v1/openai/models and routes chat traffic to /v1/openai/chat/completions. Uses the current clovastudio.stream.ntruss.com host — the legacy clovastudio.apigw.ntruss.com endpoint is being deprecated.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.codestral: Connect Codestral with an API key.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.codex: Connect OpenAI Codex with the existing OAuth flow.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.cohere: Free Trial: 1,000 API calls/month for testing, no credit card required
onboardingProviderDescriptions.command-code: Create or copy an API key from Command Code, then paste it here as a Bearer token.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.crof: Connect CrofAI with an API key.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.cursor: Connect Cursor IDE with the existing OAuth flow.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.cursor-api: Connect Cursor with a user API key (crsr_...) from cursor.com/dashboard/api; no IDE session needed.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.databricks: Connect Databricks with an API key.

onboardingProviderDescriptions.deepinfra: Free signup credits for API testing and model exploration

onboardingProviderDescriptions.dgrid: Create a DGrid API key at https://dgrid.ai, then use https://api.dgrid.ai/v1 as the OpenAI-compatible base URL.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.dify: Get API key from your Dify instance.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.digitalocean: Connect DigitalOcean with an API key.

onboardingProviderDescriptions.empower: Empower exposes OpenAI-compatible chat on https://app.empower.dev/api/v1 with tool-calling support on empower-functions.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.factory: Get your Factory API key at https://app.factory.ai/settings/api-keys, then paste it as a Bearer token. OpenAI-compatible endpoint at https://api.factory.ai/v1.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.fal-ai: Connect Fal.ai with an API key.

onboardingProviderDescriptions.fenayai: Bearer API key for the FenayAI OpenAI-compatible gateway.

onboardingProviderDescriptions.freemodel-dev: Get $300 free API credits at https://freemodel.dev — no payment info required. OpenAI-compatible endpoint. GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.5 models available.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.freepik: Generate images with Freepik's Mystic API.

onboardingProviderDescriptions.g4f-ollama: Remote g4f.space gateway to Ollama. Anonymous access requires proof-of-work credits from g4f.dev/chat or a member API key from g4f.dev/members.html; limits vary.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.g4f-pollinations: Remote g4f.space gateway to Pollinations. Anonymous access requires proof-of-work credits from g4f.dev/chat or a member API key from g4f.dev/members.html; limits vary.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.galadriel: Connect Galadriel with an API key.

onboardingProviderDescriptions.hackclub: Sign in with your Hack Club account at ai.hackclub.com.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.heroku: Connect Heroku AI with an API key.

onboardingProviderDescriptions.llamagate: Connect LlamaGate with an API key.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.llm7: Works without API key (use 'unused' as key). Get free token at token.llm7.io for higher limits.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.longcat: Free: one-time 10M-token grant after account signup + KYC verification (LongCat-2.0). One-time only — not a recurring daily/monthly allowance.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.maritalk: Connect Maritalk with an API key.

onboardingProviderDescriptions.mixedbread: Create embeddings with the Mixedbread API.

onboardingProviderDescriptions.modelscope: Free tier via ModelScope API-Inference — Alibaba account required.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.moonshot: Connect Kimi with an API key.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.nanogpt: Connect NanoGPT with an API key.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.nebius: ~$1 trial credits on signup for API testing

onboardingProviderDescriptions.novita: $0.50 trial credits on signup (valid about 1 year)
onboardingProviderDescriptions.nscale: $5 free credits on signup for inference testing
onboardingProviderDescriptions.nube: Connect Nube.sh with an API key.

onboardingProviderDescriptions.ollama-cloud: Connect Ollama Cloud with an API key.

onboardingProviderDescriptions.openvecta: Free credits on signup for OpenAI-compatible inference across LLMs, embeddings, and reasoning models

onboardingProviderDescriptions.piapi: Connect PiAPI with an API key.

onboardingProviderDescriptions.poe: Poe exposes OpenAI-compatible chat and responses on https://api.poe.com/v1, with authenticated balance checks on /usage/current_balance.

Premium models (claude, gemini, midijourney) require a Pollinations API key from enter.pollinations.ai.

onboardingProviderDescriptions.recraft: Connect Recraft with an API key.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.reka: Reka Chat is OpenAI-compatible on /v1. OmniRoute probes /v1/models and routes chat traffic to /v1/chat/completions.

onboardingProviderDescriptions.sambanova: $5 free credits on signup (30-day validity), no credit card required

onboardingProviderDescriptions.sarvam: Sarvam AI is OpenAI-compatible on /v1. OmniRoute probes /v1/models and routes chat traffic to /v1/chat/completions. Models are tuned for Indic languages.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.scaleway: 1M free tokens for new accounts — EU/GDPR compliant (Paris), Qwen3 235B & Llama 70B
onboardingProviderDescriptions.seekai: Create an API key at https://seekai.cc, then paste it here as a Bearer token. OpenAI-compatible base URL: https://seekai.cc/v1.

onboardingProviderDescriptions.voyage-ai: Bearer API key for Voyage AI embeddings and rerank APIs.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.wandb: Connect Weights & Biases Inference with an API key.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.watsonx: The watsonx model gateway exposes OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions and /models under /ml/gateway/v1.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.writer: Writer Palmyra is OpenAI-compatible at https://api.writer.com/v1. palmyra-x5 offers a 1M-token context window.

settings.resilienceAutoEnableApiKeyProvidersDesc: Enables queue protection by default for active API key connections.
settings.resilienceComboCooldownWaitDesc: For all combo strategies: wait out a short transient cooldown and re-dispatch instead of returning a 429 immediately. Never waits on quota_exhausted.
settings.resilienceComboCooldownWaitToggleDesc: All combo strategies; never waits on quota_exhausted.
settings.resilienceConnectionCooldownDesc: The base cooldown covers transient connection failures. When upstream retry hints are enabled, the provider's explicit window overrides the local cooldown.
settings.resilienceConnectionCooldownEffect: Temporarily skips that connection and increases backoff for repeated failures
settings.resilienceConnectionCooldownTrigger: When a connection returns a transient upstream failure
settings.resilienceCredentialHealthDesc: Background sweep that validates every active connection's credential by calling its provider. Set 0 to disable the sweep entirely. Per-connection Health Check values (on each connection's edit dialog) always override this global default.
settings.resilienceCredentialHealthEffect: Probes each connection's credential and marks it active/error; failed connections back off exponentially
settings.resilienceCredentialHealthHint: 0 disables the background sweep (max 1440 min = 24 h). Connections with their own Health Check value ignore this global default; a per-connection 0 opts that connection out even when the global sweep is on.
settings.resilienceCredentialHealthScope: All active API-key and OAuth connections
settings.resilienceEnableServerWaitDesc: When enabled, OmniRoute waits for the first cooldown to expire and retries automatically.
settings.resilienceProviderBreakerDesc: Live breaker state appears only on the Health page. Connection-scoped 429 rate limits stay in Connection Cooldown and do not trip the provider breaker.
settings.resilienceProviderBreakerEffect: Temporarily blocks that provider until the reset time expires
settings.resilienceProviderBreakerTrigger: Final transport/server failures after connection fallback is exhausted
settings.resilienceProviderCooldownDesc: Prevents subsequent requests from re-walking the same failing providers. Cooldown scales exponentially with consecutive failures.
settings.resilienceProviderCooldownEffect: Skips the failed provider for a cooldown period before retrying
settings.resilienceProviderCooldownEnabledDesc: When enabled, failed providers are tracked globally and skipped for a cooldown period.
settings.resilienceQuotaShareConcurrencyDesc: For quota-share combos only: when a connection sets a Max Concurrent cap, serialize concurrent requests to that subscription account so it is never flooded past its ceiling. Excess requests wait in the queue instead of getting a 429. The cap comes from each connection's Max Concurrent field; this switch only enables or disables honoring it.
settings.resilienceQuotaShareConcurrencyToggleDes: Quota-share combos only; honors each connection's Max Concurrent cap.
settings.resilienceRequestQueueDesc: This layer only controls queueing and pacing. It does not store cooldowns or open circuit breakers.
settings.resilienceRequestQueueEffect: Queues requests, limits concurrency, and spaces out calls
settings.resilienceSettingsIntro: Automatic retry, cooldown, and fallback when providers fail.
settings.resilienceStructureDesc: This page only configures behavior. Live breaker state is shown on the Health page. Combo-specific retry and round-robin slot control remain on combo settings.
settings.resilienceUseUpstream429BreakerHints: Use upstream 429 hints for breaker cooldown
settings.resilienceUseUpstream429BreakerHintsDesc: Apply Retry-After / quota-exhausted signals from 429 responses to the circuit-breaker cooldown duration. Default uses a per-provider policy: direct cloud providers default on; reverse-proxy, self-hosted, and CLI-backed providers default off. Independent of "Use upstream retry hints".
settings.resilienceUseUpstreamRetryHintsDesc: Uses retry-after/reset values from the upstream provider when available.
settings.resilienceWaitForCooldownDesc: This only affects the current request. It does not store connection or provider state.
settings.resilienceWaitForCooldownEffect: Waits on the server and retries when the first cooldown expires
settings.resilienceWaitForCooldownTrigger: When all candidate connections are already cooling down
settings.responsesStateHint: Auto strips previous_response_id unless a connection explicitly enables OpenAI Responses storage. Strip is safest for stateless clients such as VS Code Custom Endpoint; context then depends on the client sending full history.
settings.responsesStateSaveError: Failed to update Responses state setting
settings.restoreSuccess: Restored! {connections} connections, {nodes} nodes, {combos} combos, {apiKeys} API keys.
settings.ringBufferSizeDesc: Size of the ring buffer for logs
settings.routingAdvancedGuideHint1: This strategy is synced to both new combo defaults and global account fallback routing.
settings.routingAdvancedGuideHint2: Use Fill First for predictable account priority, Round Robin plus Sticky Limit for account batches, and P2C for latency resilience.
settings.routingAllOccurrencesHint: When ON (default), every instance is replaced. When OFF, only the first match is replaced.
settings.routingAntigravitySignatureBypassDesc: Accept client-provided signatures after lightweight validation and fall back to the stored signature when invalid.
settings.routingAntigravitySignatureBypassStrictD: Require full protobuf validation before accepting a client-provided signature.
settings.routingAntigravitySignatureDesc: Control whether OmniRoute reuses only stored Gemini thought signatures or accepts validated client-provided signatures in Antigravity-compatible tool-call flows.
settings.routingAntigravitySignatureEnabledDesc: Current behavior. Ignore client-provided signatures and keep using the stored OmniRoute flow.
settings.routingBillingCchAlgoHint: How the 5-char cch= token is computed. 'sha256-first-user' = sha256 of first user message text. 'xxhash64-body' = body-level signing fills it later. 'static-zero' = literal '00000' placeholder.
settings.routingBillingEntrypointHint: Value injected as 'cc_entrypoint='. Anthropic accepts 'sdk-cli' (Agent SDK), 'cli' (Claude Code CLI), or other documented values.
settings.routingBillingVersionFormatHint: How the 3-char build hash after cc_version= is computed. 'ex-machina' = sha256 of CCH_SALT+chars-from-first-user-msg+version (per-message). 'omniroute-daystamp' = sha256 of YYYY-MM-DD+version (stable per-day).
settings.routingBlockTextHint: Full text of the new system block. Use a literal string; the system block stores text only.
settings.routingCaseSensitiveHint: When ON, 'OpenCode' and 'opencode' are different strings. When OFF (default), the comparison ignores case.
settings.routingClaudeProviderDescription: Native Claude provider with OAuth-issued tokens.
settings.routingClientCacheControlAlwaysDesc: Always forward client-provided cache_control headers to upstream providers as-is.
settings.routingClientCacheControlAutoDesc: For deterministic Claude-compatible flows, preserve client-provided cache_control as-is. If the request has no cache_control, OmniRoute does not inject any bridge-owned markers for CC-compatible third-party proxy compatibility.
settings.routingClientCacheControlDesc: Configure whether OmniRoute preserves client-provided cache_control markers
settings.routingClientCacheControlNeverDesc: Always remove client cache_control headers and let OmniRoute manage caching where native provider flows support it.
settings.routingConfigMustBeObject: Config must be a JSON object
settings.routingIdempotencyKeyHint: Optional. If set, the op skips when a block whose text starts with this key is already present. Prevents double-prepend on retries.
settings.routingJsonEditorLabel: JSON (edit and apply, or paste to import)
settings.routingMatchLiteralHint: Exact literal substring to find. No regex syntax — special chars like . * ? are treated as themselves.
settings.routingNeedlesHint: List of substrings. A paragraph matches if it contains ANY one of them. Add one per line via 'Add entry'.
settings.routingObfuscateTargetsHint: Which body regions to scan for the words: system blocks, user/assistant messages, and/or tool descriptions.
settings.routingObfuscateWordsHint: Lowercase words to obfuscate. ZWJ insertion is applied case-insensitively, so 'opencode' also matches 'OpenCode' and 'OPENCODE'.
settings.routingOpAppendSystemBlockDesc: Inserts a new text block at the END of the system array. Use for cosmetic additions that don't need to be at position [0].
settings.routingOpDropBlockContainsDesc: Removes ENTIRE system blocks (not just paragraphs) whose text contains any of the listed substrings. Use when a whole block is fingerprint-bearing and you want it gone — e.g. an injected MCP-server description.
settings.routingOpDropParagraphContainsDesc: Removes any paragraph (text block split on blank lines) inside the system prompt whose text contains ANY of the listed substrings. Use to strip third-party client fingerprints like 'github.com/anomalyco/opencode' or 'docs.openwebui.com' that Anthropic's classifier flags.
settings.routingOpDropParagraphStartsWithDesc: Removes any paragraph that STARTS WITH one of the listed prefixes. Use for identity lines like 'You are OpenCode' or 'You are Open WebUI' that announce the calling client.
settings.routingOpInjectBillingHeaderDesc: Prepends the special 'x-anthropic-billing-header: cc_version=...; cc_entrypoint=...; cch=...;' text block that Anthropic's classifier validates. Required for CC bridge relay endpoints; for the native claude provider OmniRoute already injects its own billing line so this op is usually redundant there.
settings.routingOpObfuscateWordsDesc: Inserts a Zero-Width-Joiner character after the first letter of each listed word, so 'opencode' becomes 'o‍pencode'. Reads identical to humans but bypasses classifier word matches. Targets system blocks, user/assistant messages, and tool descriptions.
settings.routingOpPrependSystemBlockDesc: Inserts a new text block at the FRONT of the system array. Use to add the SDK identity 'You are a Claude agent, built on Anthropic's Claude Agent SDK.' that Anthropic's classifier expects.
settings.routingOpReplaceRegexDesc: Replaces text matching a regular expression. Use when you need patterns (character classes, optional whitespace, anchors) instead of literal substrings. A malformed pattern is caught at runtime when the op runs.
settings.routingOpReplaceTextDesc: Replaces a literal substring with another literal substring. Use for known trigger phrases — e.g. rewrite 'Here is some useful information about the environment you are running in:' to 'Environment context you are running in:' (an empirically-validated trigger phrase).
settings.routingOpSummaryCount: {count, plural, =0 {no ops} one {# op} other {# ops}}
settings.routingPatternHint: JavaScript regex source. Don't wrap in slashes — just 'foo(.*)bar'. Server rejects patterns that fail to compile.
settings.routingPipelineMustBeArray: `pipeline` must be an array of ops
settings.routingPrefixesHint: List of strings. A paragraph matches if it starts with any one of them (leading whitespace is trimmed before matching).
settings.routingRegexFlagsHint: JavaScript regex flags (g = all matches, i = case-insensitive, s = dot matches newline, m = multiline). Default 'g'.
settings.routingReplacementTextHint: Replacement string. Leave blank to delete the match. The output preserves surrounding text.
settings.routingRuleHint: Add a rule like claude-opus* -> frontier-combo to automatically route requests.
